edges.reason: msg.sender is read in the _transfer blacklist require check.
tx.origin is read in the _transfer blacklist require check, creating origin-based authorization.
msg.sender is used as the sender account in deliver.
msg.sender is compared with _previousOwner in unlock to authorize ownership restoration.
block.timestamp is compared with _lockTime to gate unlock, making it timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is added to time to compute _lockTime in lock.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline to the router.
block.timestamp is passed as the liquidity deadline to the router.
msg.sender is returned by the _msgSender context helper.

_transfer invokes swapAndLiquify, which makes external calls and sends ETH before state updates complete.

_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferToExcluded.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only flows into _transfer, so it should be merged into that core function node.
The recipient parameter exists solely to feed _transfer and should collapse into it.
The from parameter is the source operand of _transfer's accounting.
The to parameter is the destination operand of _transfer's accounting.
tAmount is the token amount consumed by _transferStandard and its sibling transfer paths.
The tokens parameter is only used as the swap input of swapAndLiquify.
The time parameter is only used to derive _lockTime inside lock.
newOwner is only used to update _owner inside transferOwnership.
account is the operand of the owner-only blacklist update in addBotToBlacklist.
newAddress is only used to reassign the marketing wallet in updateMarketingWallet.
takeFee is a local control flag consumed by _tokenTransfer's fee-mode dispatch.
maxTxPercent is only used in the arithmetic of setMaxTxPercent.
tokenAmount is the swap input of swapTokensForEth.
ethAmount is the ETH value forwarded by addLiquidity.
